attestations.note: The life page `/3228/` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and in place of a life it prints a supposition and a bibliography. **The page marks it as a supposition and so does this folder**: «Ο Άγιος Νικόδημος ο Αγιορείτης υποθέτει ότι ο Όσιος αυτός είναι ο λεγόμενος Πάνδεκτος», the author of the Pandektes, who lived in the middle of the 7th century, came from Galatia and was a monk at the monastery of Saint Sabbas in Jerusalem, who described the sack of Jerusalem by the Arabs and lamented the killing of the monks of the Lavra. **No `dates` object and no second `types` entry are drafted**, because the century and the monastic life both belong to the identification Nikodemos only supposes; `venerable` is from the calendar's own «Όσιος». The page's closing bibliography — Archimandrite Kallistos's study of 1910 and I. Phokylides's «Ἡ Ἱερὰ Λαύρα Σάββα τοῦ ἡγιασμένου» — is recorded in the life. He is none of the corpus's four other Antiochuses, who are kept on other days. No hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
